name: AGF A/S
summary: Headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark, AGF A/S operates extensively within the sports and facilities management sectors. Its sporting endeavors encompass a wide array of activities, including generating income from television rights, securing sponsorships, facilitating player transfers, overseeing match operations, offering physiotherapy services, and participating in e-sports. In addition to its sports focus, the company manages facilities, handling property rentals and venue leasing, particularly at Ceres Park and Arena, where it hosts diverse events ranging from vendor sales to conferences and musical performances. AGF A/S is also responsible for managing the AGF football team and its elite youth squad, alongside its restaurant and catering businesses. Established in 1880, the company adopted its current name, AGF A/S, in December 2017, having previously operated as Aarhus Elite A/S.
